common.defenses: Use actual acquired Counterspell, reflection, immunity, antimagic, dispel and concentration records within exact scope, not spell names or guessed ranks. All four are rank8 for applicable checks. A class Wizard Dispel is rank3 at its printed3RP/check10+target rank; it is never Greater Dispel rank5. Source-specific counter success is necessary; a suppressed effect is not terminated unless its source says so. New Animal concentration ends old same-caster concentration at commitment, before counter/save/failure. Nonconcentration Clone/Flesh/Perfect do not end other concentration unless Ready does.
common.returnsAndOwnership: Preserve actors, real body and item IDs, personal HP/max ledger, temporaryHP, Wounds/injuries, actual conditions, paid resources, spent turn markers, debts, death and return histories. Do not infer ownership, loyalty, soul geography, CR, content permission, creature roster or preparation from a title. Actual death ends concentration and only the effects whose sources end on death; completed memory losses and other persistent personal consequences are retained. Every fixture is synthetic data for a static rule trace, not an acquired campaign character or physical-world proof.
common.holds: Source/access/content/form/body geometry/identity topology/runtime/human-play/balance/release holds survive this return. A missing prerequisite holds the whole dependent case or branch; it cannot be narrated as a positive actual campaign result. All changed rules below are NEW only for these four spells.

rules.eligibility: NEW one willing living physical creature-origin identity with a documented reproducible persistent root body. Perceive the source within120ft/LoE and designate a legal unoccupied growth envelope adjacent to it and also within120ft/LoE, same established plane. No printed vessel, blood sample, gem or extra price is added. Physical Constructs are not automatically excluded if actually living/reproducible by their own source; HP-only animations, transformed objects and temporary summoned bodies gain no Clone eligibility by appearance. Unknown reproduction/physiology holds the whole dependent branch. Validate the entire root body envelope, mass and missing parts, excluding temporary form anatomy and gear.
rules.growth: NEW the paid instantaneous cast produces one full-size inert immature physical duplicate at that anchor; it never acts, has no personal identity, inventory, class resources or companion slot. Maturity at createdAt+86400elapsedseconds, phase0 before a new death check at equality. No concentration; clock continues in antimagic. The magical rank8 insurance link persists until consumed, replaced, destroyed with the body, or actually ended by a source-qualified dispel. Caster death alone does not end it. Physical matter is not a maintained magical body and does not vanish in suppression.
rules.body: NEW dormant replacement body uses object-like structural AC10 and20structuralHP, no resistance, immunity, regeneration or separate personal HP pool. At structural0 it is destroyed and its entitlement ends. The intact viable-return gate requires structuralHP20 and no new anatomy/storage damage; partial damage blocks return until actual applicable repair restores structural20 and anatomy. Structural repair never heals the source character. Dormancy supplies only no metabolic air/food/water consumption while uninhabited, an explicit Clone-local completion; temperature, fire, pressure, decay, crushing and physical movement use actual applicable sources. No implicit safe vessel, preservation against environmental harm or free moving body. Repeated paid casts can leave multiple inert physical bodies; the finite cap is one live entitlement, not a world population limit. Missing hazard/storage content holds the affected branch. Detached matter or replaced bodies do not acquire autonomous life, XP, harvest awards or new spell fuel by this procedure.
rules.entitlement: NEW at most one live insurance entitlement per source identity across all casters. Only successful valid new establishment replaces the old link, not its physical body. Failed/blocked/countered attempt leaves the older link. Store unique entitlementId, bodyId, sourceIdentity, creator, body snapshot, timestamps, suppression, condition and attempted death IDs. Consumed/replaced bodies have no duplicate entitlement; their physical provenance remains.
rules.trigger: NEW actual completed death, after applicable would-die replacements and actual death triggers, opens one immediate optional return attempt. Earlier survival means no death ID and no Clone attempt. Require actual identity dead, actual willingness, mature/intact eligible unclaimed body, unsuppressed/unended link, legal destination and real return permissions. Another already successful return/claim wins; there can be only one living personal identity. Check identity-level barriers such as actual Soul Bind globally by their exact scope. Clone uses the stored body as its local return anchor: corpse-local Mass Resurrection Denial at the old corpse alone does not block a different stored anchor outside it; a matching actual barrier at the stored body does. Old corpse remains is not the paid return body. Cross-plane routing and unknown soul/topology facts are held, not granted by range120.
rules.claim: NEW resolve one atomic claim of the eligible body and identity, consume entitlement once, retire the dormant structuralHP pool (retain its historical damage record but it is no longer an active pool), then assign life1normalHP with present lawful maximum and protected lethal-track handling from the later healing/death closure. No HP-healing multiplier or living cannot-regain-HP effect converts this life assignment to healing or0HP. Actual life/identity barrier prevents claim before assignment. Record this death ID attempted even on decline/immaturity/suppression/occupation/barrier failure; no queued resurrection, delayed eligibility, repeat or replay. An intact unconsumed link may remain for a later genuinely distinct death after an actual intervening return, not continued retry of this death. Destroyed/replaced/ended links cannot.
rules.conservation: Return relocates the one personal identity into the actual clone body; physical old remains and their actual gear persist at their old positions but all other remains lose duplicate-return eligibility. No cloned gear, RP, spellbook, slots, daily uses, Wounds, injuries, exhaustion, debt or memory reset. Present personal scores/progression and HP ledger apply, not the creation snapshot. Concentration ended on death stays ended. Current personal injuries remain functional restrictions on the stored body; an older intact limb is not permission to cure a current missing-limb injury. Actual clone damage imposes its own restrictions too. Unsupported anatomy reconciliation is held; no mass/limb restoration is inferred. Protected Exhaustion6 returns alive and collapsed under later healing/death, not immediately re-killed by maximum recomputation.
rules.suppressionAndTermination: Actual antimagic suppresses only the magical link/attempt, not physical stored matter or maturation time. Ending suppression never replays old death. A source-qualified successful rank8 dispel ends the link permanently but leaves the body inert. Moving/damaging/storage acts require actual actors/actions/material predicates. No indestructible remote soul container or soul-sensing information is granted.
